articles.title: Indian police crack down on 'Cockroach' protest in Delhi - DW.com
articles.description: Indian authorities have imposed extraordinary security measures to block protesters from joining a demonstration called by the Cockroach Janta Party in New Delhi. The main leaders of the party have been detained too.
articles.content:
Videos released by opposition leaders show that several senior figures were detained in New Delhi on Saturday.
